description:
The Firmstrong CA-520 7-Speed takes the classic cruiser experience and reimagines it for modern performance. While it retains the iconic, high-arching aluminum frame that Firmstrong is known for, the 7-speed drivetrain and handbrakes make this bike significantly more versatile than a standard model. It is particularly well-suited for riders who want to tackle hills or enjoy long-distance treks without sacrificing the relaxed, laid-back feel of a beach cruiser. Optimized with a specialized "Foot-Forward" frame geometry, the CA-520 provides a balanced and spacious fit for most men from 5’4” up to 6’2” tall.

The Innovation of Forward Pedaling What sets the CA-520 apart is its ergonomic frame design, similar to our AnyJourney series. Unlike typical bicycles where the pedals sit directly below your hips, the pedals on the CA-520 are moved forward, allowing you to ride with your feet positioned comfortably in front of you. This creates a more stretched-out, low-gravity feel that allows the seat to be positioned lower to the ground while still providing full leg extension. For taller riders, this design is a game-changer, providing the necessary legroom to prevent a cramped riding position and allowing for a "feet-on-ground" stance when stopped.

Precision Shimano 7-Speed Performance At the core of the CA-520 7-Speed is the Shimano gear system, widely considered the best seven-speed option for a cruiser. This system uses a derailleur to move the chain smoothly between sprockets as you shift using the intuitive RevoShift. Gear one offers minimal resistance, making it ideal for managing inclines or maintaining a steady, slow pace. Gear seven provides the maximum resistance needed for high-speed cruising and coasting downhill. This range gives you the functionality of a hybrid bike while keeping you in the signature upright riding position that minimizes strain on your back and shoulders.

Enhanced Safety with Tektro V-Brakes To manage the increased speed of this 7-speed model, the CA-520 comes equipped with front and rear Tektro V-brakes. These hand-operated brakes provide significantly more stopping power and precision control than a traditional coaster brake, which is essential for safely navigating city traffic or descending hills. The system also features a rear freewheel, allowing you to pedal backward freely without engaging the brakes. The CA-520 7-Speed is a durable, lightweight, and rust-resistant upgrade for anyone who wants a vintage aesthetic paired with modern, go-anywhere performance.

Pair it up: The Hyna 7-Speed is the recommended ladies' companion for the CA-520.

17” Extended Length Aluminum Frame

7 Speed Shimano Bicycle has a wide range of gears for all types of riding; short rides, long distance and uphill riding

Great recreational riding bike for taller men or those who would like more leg and arm extension. Foot-Forward Design moves pedals forward for a more spacious, ergonomic ride and full leg extension.

Forward pedaling design allows riders to keep seat closer to ground while still getting proper leg extension

Frame Geometry makes riders feels less cramped, creating a more “kicked back” “relaxed” ride

Circular, High Arching Top Tube Frame Design

Dual Spring Oversized Seat for Added Comfort

2.125” Wide Black Tires provide a cushioned, relaxed ride for easy rolling

28.5” Wide Cruiser Bike Handlebars with Synthetic Leather Grips

Bicycle Weighs 33.5 lbs. Fully Assembled

Fits Most Men 5’4” – 6’2” Tall

Recommended Riding Speed 3 – 30mph

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 40 miles in a single trip

The Seat and Handlebar Height and Tilt can be adjusted to properly fit the rider

Bike comes 85% Assembled, Assembly is easy and fun!

Designed in Hermosa Beach, CA.
